[[Saidra]] is one of the leaders of the [[Shining Blade]]. She is first seen in mission cutscenes before appearing as allies in several missions. She sacrifices herself in the [[Ice Caves of Sorrow]] mission so the players' party can escape approaching [[Mursaat]].

== Trivia ==
* During [[Riverside Province]] she will be disguised with the same model as [[Chosen Villager]]s.
* [[Saidra's Ashes]] can be found in [[Sparkfly Swamp]].
* Although you can keep her alive during the mission, you cannot prevent Saidra's self-sacrifice: if you heal her, she can survive the fight, but eventually disappears afterward.
